title: Advisor
summary: An /advisor skill that asks the model in your ACS advisor role for an outside verdict on scope and direction before you commit to a plan.

explain.what: The advisor skill brings in an outside consultant: the model in your advisor role (or its second opinion, or both). It reads a short brief and the files that matter and says whether the plan is right-sized, what to change or cut, and only the questions a human really has to decide.
explain.does: Day to day you say /advisor at a scope-shaping moment. Your agent writes the brief, runs the advisor read-only, checks its points against the code, and shows you the verdict with its own agreement or disagreement. The advisor never edits anything, and the skill proves which model answered.
changes: ~/.claude/skills/advisor/ and ~/.codex/skills/advisor/ (the skill and its contract, for the harnesses you have)
explain.undo: Uninstalling removes the skill folders. A file you edited after installing is kept and reported.

changes: ~/.claude/skills/advisor/SKILL.md and advisor-contract.md (Claude Code; Grok reads this folder too)
